title: re-arm-on-deposit cluster — BitBay UsdcDaiV4Vault (Polygon), X7 Finance X7Pioneer (Ethereum), Unistreet LaunchpadFactoryAuto (Ethereum), DAOstack Genesis Alpha (Ethereum)
closed_reasons: BitBay: vault empty (0 DAI/USDC, liquidity 0) AND mintThis=true since block 95,605,021 (2026-10-16 01:07:39 UTC) gates reposition() to the minter
X7: pool holds 0.021581 ETH ($52.72) but the drain requires owning a never-claimed tokenId; zero marketplace listings, no public mint, airdrop disabled — no acquisition path for a fresh attacker
Unistreet: factory custodies 0 LP positions (POSM.balanceOf(factory)=0); launchpad dormant since 2026-08-05
DAOstack: Genesis Alpha avatar holds 0 ETH (drained 4.025 ETH on 2026-09-26); no other org on the shared UController holds funds

bitbay.fork_measured: 5,000.34 DAI swept by 1-wei share; net 4,969.39 DAI; profitable >~$40 pot

x7.fork_measured: B=0.021581 ETH captured net; +0.5 ETH deposit captured 100% in cycle 2

daostack.fork_measured: re-funded 4.025 ETH avatar -> fresh attacker captured 4.0256 ETH

key_facts: BitBay _withdraw() liquidity==0 branch pays the entire DAI+USDC balance with no share weighting; the Oct-9-2026 incident (tx 0x5b795dc5..., 14,838 DAI) used deposit(1 wei) + boundary swap + permissionless reposition() + withdraw(1)

BitBay: the zero-liquidity outcome requires the swap price limit sqrtPriceAtTick(tickUpper+1)-1 (price in the last wei of tick tickUpper) so _getRequiredRatio integer-rounds to 0; this detail was fork-derived and is what makes reposition leave newLiquidity=0

BitBay live change during this investigation: minter 0xC70F0Ec950c51BB4E410A94c21468247bFDdF29c called minterOnly(true) at 2026-10-16 01:07:39 UTC (Polygon block 95,605,021); non-minter reposition now reverts OnlyMinter (fork-verified)

BitBay minter-mode race: with mintThis=true the attack still works if the attacker parks the price at the range-top boundary and the minter's routine recentering reposition zeroes liquidity; any 1-wei share then sweeps everything (fork-verified with impersonated minter)

X7 claimRewards bumps totalRewards by (balance-lastETHBalance) on every call but refreshes lastETHBalance only when claimable>0; the incident left totalRewards=21,580.12e18 so a fresh attacker needs L~33.80 ETH flash loan to keep the payout <= balance; net = whole pool balance

X7: 639 tokens total, 223 permanently transfer-unlocked; zero listings anywhere today; only price precedent 0.15 ETH ($384.63, Blur 2026-10-08, token 300 bought by the attacker 44 min before the exploit); the original attacker still owns unlocked token 300; unclaimedRewards(300)=0 and unclaimed tokens revert (claimable 33.77 ETH > balance) so the 0.0216 ETH is not even holder-recoverable

Unistreet launch() forwards caller initCalldata/modifyCalldata verbatim into POSM.multicall as the factory (owner of every launch LP NFT) -> setApprovalForAll injection -> BURN_POSITION+TAKE_PAIR sweep; factory is NOT a proxy (EIP-1967 slots zero, 9,323-byte runtime)

Unistreet: 4 operator approvals injected during the Aug-2026 incident are still live on POSM today (0xc7d8C70F..., 0xEda1f193..., 0x3C59433D..., 0xDE2e6079...); incident drained 15/15 positions incl. a second factory 0xd5799fd8...

DAOstack UController.newOrganization is permissionless and trusts the caller-supplied avatar's nativeReputation()/nativeToken() (shape-shifting fake avatar) -> register as 0x1F scheme against the victim's Reputation -> mintReputation majority -> propose/vote/execute -> sendEther; fresh-attacker path still works today (fork-verified)

DAOstack: incumbent attacker schemes (0x304a8e57..., perms 0x1F) remain registered on Genesis Alpha and still pass sendEther/externalTokenTransfer/mintTokens/registerScheme/upgradeController via eth_call; attacker #2 holds 99.85% of Genesis reputation
Only 3 orgs were ever registered on the shared UController (Genesis Alpha + 2 fake attacker avatars, both empty); no other live orgs with funds

Unistreet: Launched events on 0xFB60CD0B36aD4bD839b91767a6Ad9055AB6aD825, POSM.balanceOf(factory)>0, new isApprovedForAll(factory,*) grants
DAOstack: any ETH transfer to avatar 0x7b11dFb29504abc8C0DFA60DC7E0Aa2AAe836DB0; newOrganization/mintReputation/sendEther events on UController 0xD5bEe5D9Ae589094c51e533f35656963fdA87305
caveats: X7 acquisition blocker could vanish if any unlocked token is listed below the pool balance; pool balance grows with fee inflows
BitBay trigger (b) requires holding the exact boundary price until the minter repositions (arbitrage pressure); code path proven, real-world race not tested against bots
DAOstack fresh-attacker capture assumes dormant incumbent rep holders do not coordinate a NO vote; minting 2x supply keeps YES above all incumbent NO votes at the current distribution

Unistreet victim-launch calldata is a byte-exact re-encoding of the incident's own Pigcon launch with a fresh salt (eth_call + fork e2e verified); marketplace/floor data for X7 comes from public pages (provided OpenSea key invalid/401)
All PoCs are fork-only; no mainnet transaction was signed or sent; no keyed RPC URLs or secrets in any file
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live across all four re-arm-on-deposit targets; every one of them re-arms in full on the next deposit/launch/funding (BitBay 100% of vault balance incl. a minter-mode race, X7 100% of contract balance once a token is acquirable, Unistreet 100% of each new launch's LP, DAOstack 100% of any avatar inflow) — fork-verified with 12/12 tests.
